result:
I’d make it impossible to be indifferent to another mind.

Not forced love. Not sameness. Just a permanent, bone-deep recognition that the person in front of you is as real, afraid, hopeful, and pain-capable as you are. Most of the world’s worst things—war, exploitation, cruelty, neglect—depend on a small act of forgetting that. Remove that forgetting, and everything else would have to be rebuilt around a much harder truth.
